text:
maria: Heads-up — Metrics Grid is freezing for long-range queries in prod. Steps: Dashboard -> Metrics Grid -> 30d, set rows to 5000, UI becomes unresponsive. Seen by SRE on us-east.

ravi: Can repro locally when I bump rows to ~4k with sample data. Any console errors/logs?

lucy: Got a trace. The new metrics_v2 client bundle is being lazy-loaded, but fallback path still pulls the old renderer. On certain route combos both bundles initialize and we end up with two heavy react trees + duplicate data work. :face_with_rolling_eyes:

joel: metrics_v2 was rolled out to 25% last night for canary. Should we flip it back to 0% while we debug?

infra-bot: quota-service: returning 429 for /api/metrics?range=30d&rows=5000 from 2026-03-19T14:02:12Z due to concurrent_query_limit=60 -> circuit-breaker tripped.

maria: Interesting — the 429 causes client to switch to polling fallback which requests more granular pages and triggers heavy row layout work. Also telemetry shows metrics.render events with payload sizes >800KB; sampler drops those so we miss the trace context.

ravi: Isn't the circuit-breaker per-route? If so, we should make a separate, lighter route for large-range streaming that doesn't trigger client-side fallback.

lucy: We need three things: 1) revert metrics_v2 rollout for those affected users, 2) add server-side soft limit on rows (and cursor/streaming endpoint), 3) fix client bundling so vendor/chart code isn't duplicated on fallback.

maria: Quick repro curl:
```bash
curl -H 'x-client-id:metrics-grid' 'https://console.internal/api/metrics?range=30d&rows=5000' -v
```
Response shows: 200 then a burst of 429s as concurrency limit is exceeded.

joel: I'll approve a rollback flag PR. Ravi, can you open the server-side limit + cursor ticket? Lucy, can you look into bundle split boundaries?

ravi: On it — will create a ticket and add a soft-limit header like X-Result-Limit:2000 and a streaming cursor endpoint /api/metrics/stream.

lucy: For bundling: current split point is app -> metrics_v2 -> charts. The lazy chunk includes charting lib + renderer. Fallback path pulls renderer from legacy chunk; both get initialized. Proposed: move charting into a single vendor chunk shared by both paths, and delay heavy layout until data arrives (avoid expensive rowHeight recalc during mount).

maria: Temporary client-side mitigation: limit rows to 1000 for the new grid variant and enable virtualization toggles. I'll push a config change to the rollout to cap at 1k for groups A/B.

canary-bot: canary: metrics_v2 rollout set to 0% for cohorts 2..10 at 2026-03-19T14:18:03Z by joel

ravi: Created ENG-5421: server-side soft-limit + streaming cursor. Assigned to infra. Added acceptance: no more than 1 429 storm when a single user requests 5k rows.

lucy: Created ENG-5422: bundle split + reuse vendor charts. I'll PR a change to webpack splitChunks and add a test ensuring only one charts bundle script is loaded per page.

maria: Plan summary: revert rollout, cap client rows to 1k for v2, implement server soft-limit + streaming cursor, fix bundling so fallback doesn't instantiate duplicate renderers, add telemetry metric for double-bundle-downloads.

joel: I'll ship the rollback hotfix now. After rollback we can re-enable canary once we have streaming + bundle fix. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Hotfix deploy started: console-release-hotfix/metrics-grid-rollback -> prod canary.

canary-bot: canary: rollback deployed to 25% at 2026-03-19T14:24:50Z

maria: Confirmed: users in canary group show normal responsiveness after rollback. Closing immediate incident, moving follow-ups to ENG-5421 and ENG-5422.

ravi: Will monitor quota-service metrics and open follow-up for routing policy adjustments (per-route circuit-breaker thresholds).

lucy: I'll add a small histogram telemetry for bundle-init times to catch future double-inits.

maria: Thanks all. If anyone sees residual slowness ping me. :rocket:
